description: Source code for HttpNegotiateAuthenticator class, which manages obtaining authentication tokens for HTTP Negotiate (Kerberos) authentication, including account management, token requests, and error handling.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator
classes.description: Manages obtaining and handling authentication tokens for HTTP Negotiate/Kerberos authentication, including account selection, token requests, and error reporting.

classes.name: RequestData
classes.description: Holds request-specific data across asynchronous callbacks, including native result object, account info, options, and token type.

classes.name: GetAccountsCallback
classes.description: Callback class invoked after retrieving accounts, handles error cases, permission checks, and initiates token fetch.

classes.name: GetTokenCallback
classes.description: Callback class invoked after attempting to get an auth token, handles success, errors, and user interaction via broadcast receiver.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate HttpNegotiateAuthenticator with specified account type.

methods.name: getNextAuthToken
methods.description: Initiates process to obtain the next authentication token for a given principal, auth token, and delegation permission.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Processes the result bundle from token request, maps error codes, and communicates back to native code.

methods.name: requestTokenWithoutActivity
methods.description: Requests an auth token without user interaction, checking permissions and retrieving accounts.

methods.name: requestTokenWithActivity
methods.description: Requests an auth token with user interaction, handling account selection and permissions.

methods.name: lacksPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current context lacks a specific permission, with optional skip for newer Android versions.
